critical_issues_found_and_fixed.issue: Authorization bypass — no session auth check. Any unauthenticated caller could modify any user's fingerprint by providing a user_id in request body.
critical_issues_found_and_fixed.fix: Added createServerSupabaseClient session check + user_id ownership verification (403 if mismatch)

critical_issues_found_and_fixed.issue: Render runs BEFORE refinement limit check — wastes API credits on requests that will be rejected.
critical_issues_found_and_fixed.fix: Moved refinement count check and 403 response before the runFluxRender call

critical_issues_found_and_fixed.issue: CLAUDE.md Rule 1 violation — persisted to sessionStorage. Room state lost on auth redirects.
critical_issues_found_and_fixed.fix: Replaced sessionStorage with in-memory no-op storage adapter

critical_issues_found_and_fixed.issue: CLAUDE.md Rule 1 violation — sessionStorage fallback for read (getItem) and overflow write (setItem). CLAUDE.md explicitly states sessionStorage fallback was removed.
critical_issues_found_and_fixed.fix: Removed sessionStorage.getItem fallback and sessionStorage.setItem overflow fallback
